articles.summary: Discover how NuScale's SMR technology solves modern grid challenges with black-start capability, island mode, and reliable power for the AI era.

articles.summary: Framatome and NuScale Power have expanded their partnership to include European fuel fabrication and plans for U.S. production at Framatome’s Richland facility for NuScale’s NRC-approved SMR technology.

articles.summary: NuScale & Ebara Elliott Energy announced a collaborative research program to field test a commercial scale high-temperature steam compressor to integrate NuScale Power Modules™ with petrochemical plants needing process heat.
articles.title: NuScale Power and Ebara Elliott Energy Announce a Strategic Partnership to Showcase Use of Advanced Nuclear Technology to Power Petrochemical Plants
